title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: US targets Iran’s crypto sector, cites over $100M in oil-linked payments
summary: The US Treasury expanded sanctions to Iran’s digital asset sector, alleging a UAE-based broker processed over $100 million in crypto for oil sales.

title: BNB Chain activates Pasteur hard fork to strengthen bridge security
summary: BNB Chain activates the Pasteur hard fork on BSC, closing bridge and validator security gaps while targeting greater transaction capacity.

title: Korean bank taps Ripple for payments, Pakistan opens crypto licensing: Asia Express
summary: Asia’s biggest crypto hubs are locked in a tax-cut arms race, while Ripple will help Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank move money across borders.

title: CFTC, US soldier accused of illegal Polymarket bet spar over interpretation of prediction markets
summary: A judge stayed the CFTC’s civil case against a soldier who allegedly used nonpublic information for a Polymarket bet, but the regulator is trying to weigh in on the criminal case.

title: Gemini plans to distribute crypto prediction markets through Apex brokerages
summary: The proposed deal would make Gemini the exclusive venue for crypto event contracts offered through Apex’s FCM, expanding its prediction-market reach to brokerage clients.

title: Bernstein sees new USDC growth cycle, sets $140 Circle price target
summary: USDC supply increased by roughly $2 billion in seven days, with Bernstein citing higher transaction activity and several factors that could support further growth.

title: Coinbase-affiliated advocacy group endorses candidates for US midterms
summary: With just over two months until the US general election, Stand With Crypto announced its pick for politicians in its efforts to “elect the most pro-crypto Congress in history.”

title: Coinbase tokenized stocks go live on Base with Chainlink price feeds
summary: Coinbase’s B20 equities bring stocks including Apple and Nvidia onchain, allowing eligible non-US users to trade them 24/7 and use them across DeFi.

title: Bitcoin price hits $80K as 24-hour crypto short liquidations pass $220M
summary: As BTC tops $80,000 for the first time since May, price analysis warns that the market still needs to sustain higher levels to challenge the bear-market thesis.
